Write a context folder for designing a style with an AI assistant

Source: R/ai_context.R
designer_ai_context.Rd

Writes the files an AI assistant needs to design a docdesigner style well, into one folder to add to the assistant's context (attach the files to a chat, or open the folder in a coding assistant):

Usage

designer_ai_context(
  path = "docdesigner-context",
  from = "minimal",
  examples = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Folder to write. Created if it does not exist.

from

The shipped style the new style will start from. It is copied into examples/ and named in the instructions as the scaffold.

examples

Further shipped styles to copy into examples/. Two or three that differ from one another give an assistant a better sense of the range than one.

overwrite

If FALSE (default), refuse to write into a folder that already holds a context folder.

Value

The folder path, invisibly.

Details

  • AI-INSTRUCTIONS.md: how the assistant should work, what each file is for, the validator's rules and the common mistakes. Load this first.

  • brief.md: the engine's hard constraints, from designer_design_brief().

  • tokens.csv: every token with its allowed values, default and status, from designer_tokens(). The only keys that exist.

  • examples/<id>.yml: shipped styles copied with their authors' comments, as models of a well-reasoned format.yml.

  • specimen.md: a test document with every element a style sets.

  • check-style.R: a script that validates a style, renders a document with it and writes each page as a PNG, so the assistant (or you) can look at the result. Run Rscript check-style.R path/to/style.

Everything is generated from the installed package, so it describes the version you will render with. Regenerate it after updating docdesigner.
